30:25.text: And of His signs is that the heaven and earth stand
by His command. Then when He calls you with a
call from the earth, immediately you will come forth.

30:26.text: And to Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and earth. All are to Him devoutly obedient.

30:27.text: And it is He who begins creation; then He repeats it, and that is
easier for Him. To Him belongs the highest description
in the heavens and earth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

30:28.text: He presents to you an example from yourselves. Do you have among those whom your right hands possess
any partners in what We have provided for you so that you are equal therein
would fear them as your fear of one another
Thus do We detail the verses for a people who use reason.

30:29.text: But those who wrong follow their
desires without knowledge. Then who can guide one whom Allāh has sent astray? And for them there are no helpers.
